text: Select: ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), Name (pref_name), Maximum Development Phase (max_phase), Molecule Type (molecule_type), Canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_structures. Join: compound_records on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno; docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id; compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1127197'. Sort: chembl_id ascending.
